name: comp-300
blurb: Trigger button for custom Sonner toast with rich content and multiple actions.
description: Button that programmatically triggers a custom-rendered Sonner toast with success icon, message, and dual action buttons (View, Undo).
use_when: You need to display rich, multi-action notifications using Sonner's custom rendering.
avoid_when: For simple notifications; use the basic Sonner API instead.
a11y: Button is keyboard accessible. Custom toast actions are keyboard accessible.
